rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 27 November 2026 (Weekly) Executive Summary • 🟡 Hong Kong subsidiary legislation scheduled to commence on 1 March 2027 expands the Securities and Futures Commission’s listing oversight tools, including continuing and post-listing conditions and issuer information requisitions. • Listed issuer entities and securities businesses supporting affected listings should confirm applicability and plan condition-tracking, disclosure, escalation and information-response arrangements; the source does not establish a direct SME-banking duty. Hong Kong 🟡 Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) amendments 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261125-fstb-14d119b43a ⏰ Deadline: 1 March 2027 (commencement) Products: Investment, capital-markets services The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau and Securities and Futures Commission brief states that the Amendment Rules were made under section 36(1) of the Securities and Futures Ordinance, with the related Schedule 8 Order made on 17 November 2026. The instruments are scheduled for Gazette publication on 27 November 2026, Legislative Council tabling on 2 December 2026 and commencement on 1 March 2027. From commencement, the changes permit continuing listing-application conditions, post-listing conditions and issuer information requisitions; non-compliance with a post-listing condition may lead to suspension. The amendments are required for parties within their statutory perimeter, while the source does not establish a direct bank-wide obligation; listed issuer entities and securities businesses supporting affected listings may need condition tracking, issuer-disclosure, escalation and response arrangements. Monitoring: Confirm which entities, transactions and service roles are in scope, and whether the Gazette text or Legislative Council scrutiny changes the stated commencement or transition provisions. Source: Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) (Amendment) Rules 2026 and Securities and Futures Ordinance (Amendment of Schedule 8) Order 2026 Mainland/GBA No qualifying current-run developments. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No qualifying current-run benchmark developments. Watch List • Monitor the Gazette text, Legislative Council tabling and transition provisions for the Hong Kong listing amendments before the stated commencement date. Weekly Trend This week’s qualifying item is a targeted Hong Kong capital-markets legislative change; its practical effect depends on entity and service-role applicability rather than a demonstrated direct SME-banking obligation.
